key_insight: ECGWmark is a fully convolutional, quantization-free watermarking method that embeds data in ECG signals while aiming to preserve diagnostic detail and resist temporal misalignment.
clinical_relevance: It could support safer ECG data transmission in telecardiology by protecting patient metadata without heavily degrading waveform features used for diagnosis.
method: Uses a continuous, full-resolution latent space instead of lossy quantization.
Adds a localized frame-level design to improve robustness to circular phase shifts and other desynchronization.
Includes a differentiable Physiological Loss guided by a clinical classifier to preserve medical semantics.
evidence_signal: On the MIT-BIH database, the model kept channel-bit extraction accuracy above 90% under tested circular temporal shifts, with mixed effects in inter-patient diagnostic metrics.
watch_item: The reported class-level diagnostic changes are uneven, so clinical deployment would need careful validation to ensure watermarking does not alter performance across rhythm classes.
paper_title: ECGWmark: Deep Watermarking for Electrocardiogram Signals
